    Try it yourself

    Practice on your own machine after each chapter.

    Practice with the practice kit or other low-risk files. P4 data is never allowed. Review every result before you share it.

    Practice kit

    Everything you need for the exercises: made-up survey data, meeting notes, an n8n workflow with two problems to find, a daily meeting brief skill, and an answer key. Exercises 1 to 4 and 6 need no accounts or plugins. Download the kit, unzip it, and add the harness-practice folder as a project.

    Download practice kit (.zip)

    • README.mdSetup and nine exercises, matched to the chapters.Download
    • workshop-feedback.csv42 fictional responses. Four leave the room rating blank.Download
    • meeting-notes.mdFictional pilot review notes for the follow-up draft exercise.Download
    • weekly-feedback-digest.n8n.jsonAn inactive n8n workflow with two problems to find.Download
    • daily-meeting-brief/SKILL.mdA skill for a daily meeting brief. The zip puts it in .agents/skills so the practice project can use it.Download
    • answer-key.mdExpected numbers and what to look for. Try first.Download

    Use case library

    Starter prompts that put the plugins to work, drawn from how campus staff already use the Harness. Each card lists the plugin abilities it needs. Anything marked write asks first in Supervised mode.

    Plugin and skill catalog

    Everything currently included, taken from the plugin and skill definitions that ship with the Harness. Reading is usually on from the start. Opt-in abilities stay off until you switch them on in Settings › Plugins.

    Recording scriptNarration, timecodes, and shot list for a screen-recorded version
    Record on one versionUse the same Harness version for every chapter, and note it in the recording. Screens can shift between versions.
    Keep real work off screenUse the demo project at ~/harness-training-demo/workshop-feedback (fictional data), and use Filter threads by project so only its threads show.
    Part 4 is its own modulePlugins and skills live only in Part 4, so you can re-record it when new ones ship. In Settings › Plugins, press Refresh if the list looks empty.
    One beat, one actionEach row is one on-screen change. Hold 1–2 seconds after it lands. The narration column is your caption file.

    The screens are rebuilt from recorded runs of TritonAI Harness in September 2026, using a demo project with fictional data. Plugin examples use sample data. The computer use and app-building scenes are real captures from those runs. The Harness keeps improving, so your screens may look slightly different. Request access or download at tritonai.ucsd.edu/developer-apis/start.html.
